sampling_rules.timing: Prediction metrics use the lowest timing_repeat (normally 0); costs use per-instance medians over timing attempts.
sampling_rules.search_times: first_best_time is the earliest known full-budget final-risk incumbent (zero for the initial constant-risk-one test). time_to_gap is the earliest valid global/enumeration interval meeting its declared tolerance. Each time uses the median of reached timing runs; unreached runs remain null and valid-run counts are reported. Explicit certificate failures suppress proof-time and checkpoint-interval statistics while retaining raw traces.
sampling_rules.synthetic: Means and sample SD across data IDs; baseline-minus-global differences use 2000 paired bootstrap resamples.
sampling_rules.tabular: Paired split differences and SD only; random splits reuse observations and are not independent test populations.
sampling_rules.har: Average training repetitions within each held-out person, then weight people equally; bootstrap people, not windows or training repetitions.
sampling_rules.failures: Available finite metrics include timeouts and fallback tests. Missing metrics and failed records remain in denominator tables.
sampling_rules.scope: Every summary retains manifest, suite, data kind/model, D, n, s, budget, radius, role and initialization. Frozen plans declare missing outcomes; no missing metric is imputed.
